# Adaptive Entanglement Depth

This repository establishes the optimal depth of one-dimensional adaptive Bell-pair preparation with independent noisy measurement reports. The central result is Theta(sqrt(log L)) at fixed report-flip probability 0<p<1/2 and fixed target Bell overlap 1/2<F0<1.

## Essential contract

- Product initialization; one qubit per site on a nearest-neighbor line.
- Perfect quantum gates, storage, reset, and measurement backaction.
- Every actual binary report passes through an independent BSC(p).
- At most one elementary operation per qubit per layer; readout rounds count.
- Arbitrary reliable classical computation and communication are free.
- Two designated physical endpoint qubits remain available after correction.
- Fixed-fidelity and fixed-noise asymptotics; no full noisy-gate fault-tolerance claim.

## Questions and destinations

To assess arbitrary adaptive protocols, inspect the erased-corridor separator in science/converse.md. The entire accessible transcript must be preserved, not only the unconditional endpoint state.

To verify achievability, inspect the exact gate layers and arbitrary-length partition in science/construction.md, then run python3 verification/verify_construction.py.

To compare with noisy quantum buses, read references/RELATED_WORK.md. The closest full-circuit converse permits quantum-gate faults absent from this readout-only model. Rare-cut decompositions and repetition decoding are inherited ideas.

To interpret postselection, use the success-weighted Bell witness in science/converse.md. Conditional fidelity alone omits a charged resource.

To consider very high fidelity, read the unitary bypass in science/interpretation.md. An unrestricted square-root-logarithmic formula in inverse infidelity would miss exact preparation in O(L) depth.

To learn the result from its foundations, begin at learning/README.md. The single educational anchor is John Watrous, The Theory of Quantum Information (2018). The map has 12 background/preliminaries milestones and 18 narrative/innovation milestones, each phase progressing from local ingredients to global understanding. The bridge supplies project-specific reasoning; the source is not being cited as proving this repository's depth law.

## Evidence boundaries

Written proofs establish general inequalities and asymptotic claims. Executable checks establish finite circuit, schedule, correction, and probability consistency. Neither source comparison nor numerical tests certify exhaustive priority.
